changes.reason: Primary AS2 task is turnout and vote-share transition. A clean target-year pre-election seat-roll source is not required for this task and is not uniformly frozen for both historical years. Omitting it symmetrically avoids touching target-outcome containers merely to recover seat magnitude. Seat diagnostics remain post-judgment scoring outputs.
Exactly the protocol maximum. Four fixed batches per 128-archetype territory; batching has no semantic feedback or cross-batch state.
Use the same nine-party panel in every territory rather than conditioning the choice set on incomplete candidate-identity coverage.

Copy only blinded feature_id/status/value/conflict from the already-frozen E_reason political packets. Do not expose baseline probabilities, evidence counts, source URLs, raw names, mapping material, or documentation-density metadata to the voter judge.

Shuffle only the common political-context card across territories within year, preserving each territory's voter population and previous-election political anchor. Match context-density strata and require no territory to receive its own context.

interpretation_constraint: The severe 2016 context-discrimination warning remains mandatory. Historical AS2 performance cannot be presented as clean evidence of candidate-level causal reasoning when the supplied context lacks cross-party discrimination.
